# falco

Usage of `prufyx check` and `prufyx prepare` for this project, as
`--project falco --help` on each route prints it. Identity, stage and rule
coverage: `prufyx catalog cncf --project falco`. Shared flags, exit status and
the reference text of each route: [routes.md](routes.md).

## check cncf

```text
prufyx check cncf --project falco --falco-argv FILE --falco-distribution official_upstream|custom_build --from 0.40.0 --to 0.41.0|0.42.0 (--now RFC3339 | --knowledge-db DIR) [--falco-argv-digest SHA256] [--replay-report FILE] [--format human|json]
```

## prepare cncf

```text
prufyx prepare cncf --project falco --falco-argv FILE --from 0.40.0 --to 0.41.0|0.42.0 --falco-distribution official_upstream|custom_build [--falco-argv-digest SHA256] [--format human|json|input]
```
